```{r Setup}

library(ncdf4)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)

source(here("r/matlab_convert.R"))

```

```{r Testing the conversion function}

#See script in r/matlab_convert.r
snow_runoff <- ncdf_rr_convert("Data/Raw/PHyDAP2/PHyDAP_RDRS21_hourly_snowmelt.nc", variable_ = "snowmelt", basin_ids = c(7120966730, 7120966470), basin_names = c("cypress_ds", "cypress_us"))
```

```{r plotting snow runoff}
snow_runoff %>% 
  filter(timestamp < ymd("1980-05-01") & timestamp > ymd("1980-04-01")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(timestamp, cypress_us)) +
  geom_point()

```


```{r loading remaining datasets}

surface_runoff <- ncdf_rr_convert("Data/Raw/PHyDAP2/PHyDAP_RDRS21_hourly_runoff.nc", variable_ = "cropped_runoff", basin_ids = c(7120966730, 7120966470), basin_names = c("cypress_ds", "cypress_us"))

```
```{r plotting surface runoff}
surface_runoff %>% 
  filter(timestamp < ymd("1980-05-01") & timestamp > ymd("1980-04-01")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(timestamp, cypress_us)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
surface_runoff <- ncdf_rr_convert("Data/Raw/PHyDAP2/PHyDAP_RDRS21_hourly_runoff.nc", variable_ = "cropped_runoff", basin_ids = c(7120966730, 7120966470), basin_names = c("cypress_ds", "cypress_us"))
```
